name: LI.FI GasZipFacet arbitrary call
summary: GasZipFacet passed caller-controlled swap data to LibSwap without the allowlist validation used by other facets, enabling arbitrary transferFrom calls against wallets with unlimited LI.FI approvals.
notes: DiamondCut added GasZipFacet 0xf28a352377663ca134bd27b582b1a9a4dad7e534 and the vulnerable depositToGasZipERC20 selector 0x3d86ea87.
LI.FI's incident report estimates approximately $11.6 million stolen across Ethereum and Arbitrum from 153 wallets and identifies USDC, USDT, and DAI among the drained assets.
The official loss is an approximate combined Ethereum-and-Arbitrum incident total; per-asset and per-chain quantities are not published.
